criteria.name: Points
criteria.answer: Points are classes of places whose companion branch states coincide (W = 1); they are label-free.

criteria.name: Distance
criteria.answer: The witness angle α = arccos √W (Fubini–Study) is a metric, unique up to scale under additivity; at small λ it is Euclidean, α ≈ λ‖u_h − u_h′‖.

criteria.name: Neighbourhood and locality
criteria.answer: Neighbours follow the relative-neighbourhood rule; edges need contracts across the cut; influence spreads one cell per order of λ (perturbative light cone).

criteria.name: Paths
criteria.answer: Euclidean and spherical limits have unique geodesics; periodic chain geometries are polygonal (anisotropic, non-unique geodesics); random local arrangements are isotropic (numerical evidence).

criteria.name: Dimension
criteria.answer: The dimension is the record capacity of the medium, fixed by the description; continuum limits exist, except for compact local records, which collapse.

criteria.name: Body
criteria.answer: Localized, persistent, label-free bodies exist, with positions and a two-body distance.

criteria.name: Background
criteria.answer: Points are identified through places and merge only at isolated λ; the neighbour structure is stable below λ* > 0, with λ* ∼ 1/size for linear records and independent of size for local ones.

criteria.name: Time
criteria.answer: Handed over to the time project; all rates here are per λ.

criteria.name: Velocity and acceleration
criteria.answer: Currents, velocity and a contract-implied maximal speed v_max; an exact acceleration identity.

criteria.name: Localized cost
criteria.answer: Cost is locally conserved on the background; inertia equals the edge (motion) cost; binding adds inertia |E_bind|/v_max² on the chain.

criteria.name: State-dependent geometry
criteria.answer: Bodies change the geometry only through non-commuting records, locally; curvature has three sources; a mediated influence exists but is not sourced by cost.

criteria.name: Common space
criteria.answer: Identical probes share one background; two types share points only if their record clouds are translates, otherwise only displacements compare.
